description: Reads a site: status and files (200 at a time); path: one file, paths: several; as_of or version: older copies. With site_token, also whether it was claimed. download: true gives 1-hour zip links of the whole site; check: "accessibility" runs the Accessibility check.

as_of.description: With path(s): as live at this ISO date-time

check.description: The full Accessibility check of the live pages (problems, fixes)

download.description: true: 1-hour links to the whole live site as zips (one per GB)

path.description: One file (live unless as_of or version)

paths.description: Up to 20 files, 512 KB in all (the rest say not_read)

version.description: With path(s): from this version number

name: get_site
title: Read site
